title: Soave sia il vento
subtitle: Fiordiligi, Dorabella and Don Alfonso: terzettino from Così fan tutte, Act 1 (No. 10)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 6, No. 10 Terzettino

licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 64–68, bars 1–41 of No. 10
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, slurs and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. The tempo word is printed in Peters' brackets, [Andante]. In bar 12 the small notes for Fiordiligi and Dorabella are grace notes; bars 39–41 are for the piano alone. Playback tempo: a half note ≈ 27 (♩ = 53), from Rattle (2:56) and Klemperer (3:15); Mozart gives the word Andante only.
